panels.description: Measures how long the Redis instance has been running.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Number of replicas connected to a primary instance.
panels.title: Connected Slaves

panels.description: Lag in seconds between master and each connected replica. Lower is better.
panels.title: Replica Lag

panels.description: Shows the current replication stream position of the Redis master.
panels.title: Replication Offset

panels.description: Monitors the number of connected clients to Redis.
panels.title: Connected Clients

panels.description: Tracks connections rejected due to max clients or resource issues.
panels.title: Rejected Connections

panels.description: Shows the maximum Redis memory fragmentation ratio over the selected time range
panels.title: Memory Fragmentation Ratio

panels.description: Memory used by Redis Lua scripts.
panels.title: Used Memory LUA

panels.description: Measures the memory usage by Redis in bytes.
panels.title: Memory Usage

panels.description: Maximum memory Redis is allowed to use
panels.title: Memory Limit

panels.description: CPU usage by Redis, broken down by system and user time.
panels.title: CPU Usage Rate

panels.description: Number of blocked clients waiting for operations to complete.
panels.title: Blocked Clients

panels.description: Shows the number of commands processed by Redis per second, calculated using the rate of the total commands counter
panels.title: Redis Commands Per Second

panels.description: Monitor key lifecycle and cache performance over time.
panels.title: Redis Keys: Expired, Evicted & Hit Rate

panels.description: Rate of incoming and outgoing network traffic.
panels.title: Network I/O

panels.description: Rate of incoming network traffic.
panels.title: Client Input Buffer

panels.description: Displays memory consumed by client output.
panels.title: Client Output Buffer

panels.description: Total NOAUTH errors — unauthorized access attempts. Non-zero value needs immediate investigation.
panels.title: NOAUTH Errors (Unauthorized Access)

panels.description: Rate of NOAUTH errors over time. A spike indicates unauthorized access or misconfigured clients.
panels.title: Redis Error Rate by Type

panels.description: Rejected command calls per command type — indicates permission or config issues.
panels.title: Rejected Commands by Type

panels.description: AOF enabled status (1=enabled) and last write/bgrewrite status (1=ok, 0=error).
panels.title: Persistence Status (AOF & RDB)

panels.description: Changes since last RDB save. High value = risk of data loss on crash. Yellow >70k, Red >100k.
panels.title: Redis RDB Backup Status

panels.description: Replication buffer memory, AOF buffer, and total replication buffer bytes.
panels.title: Replication & AOF Buffer Memory
